svg.title: Udit Gupta — about life
svg.desc: SDE at Amazon, Bengaluru. Animated midnight glass profile card; full readable static fallback.

g.text: Sub-2s query latency slashed from 30s+ on 8M+ records.
STQC & GIGW certified platforms serving 8M+ citizens.
2-year core engineering on Live Composer Page Builder.
State engine, XSS hardened & PHP 8 architecture.
Slashed ERP query latency from 30s+ to under 2s.
For the joy of a problem, solved.
